# Venice AI Documentation

> > Privacy-focused AI platform offering uncensored models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and others with TEE/E2EE security, OpenAI-compatible API, and AI agent integrations.

Venice AI provides a drop-in replacement for OpenAI's API with enhanced privacy through Trusted Execution Environments (TEE) and end-to-end encryption. The platform supports text generation (Claude Opus, GPT models), image generation and editing, video synthesis, text-to-speech, embeddings, and integrations with AI agent frameworks like Eliza and Coinbase Agentkit.

## Key Topics

- Venice API
- OpenAI-compatible API
- Claude Opus 4.5
- TEE & E2EE (Trusted Execution Environments)
- Bearer authentication
- Prompt caching
- AI agents (Eliza, Coinbase Agentkit)
- Text-to-speech (tts-kokoro)
- Image-to-video generation
- API key generation
- VVV token staking
- REST API endpoints
- Uncensored models
- Privacy-focused AI
- Cursor IDE integration

## Getting Started

- [Generating an API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/generating-api-key): Guide to generating Venice API keys for authentication and setup
- [Migrate from OpenAI](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/openai-migration): Drop-in OpenAI replacement guide: same SDK, more privacy, uncensored
- [TEE & E2EE Models](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/tee-e2ee-models): Privacy-enhanced AI using Trusted Execution Environments and encryption
- [Prompt Caching](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/prompt-caching): Reduce costs and latency with prompt caching for Claude, GPT models

## AI Agents & Integrations

- [AI Agents](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/ai-agents): Venice integration with AI agent frameworks: Eliza, Coinbase Agentkit
- [Autonomous Agent API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/generating-api-key-agent): Generate API keys for autonomous agents using VVV token staking on BASE
- [Integrations](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/integrations): Third-party integrations: ElizaOS, Akash, Molt Bot, Discord, and more
- [Cursor IDE with Venice](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/cursor): Configure Cursor IDE to use Venice AI models with venice- prefix
- [Claude Code with Venice](https://docs.venice.ai/overview/guides/claude-code): Use Anthropic's Claude Code CLI with Venice AI's Claude Opus models

## Model Documentation

- [Video Models](https://docs.venice.ai/models/video): Text-to-video and image-to-video model documentation with API references
- [Model Traits](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/models/traits): Venice API endpoint to list model traits and filter associated models

## Image API

- [Image Edit](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/image/edit): Venice API endpoint for image editing/inpainting using qwen-edit model
- [Background Remove](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/image/background-remove): Venice API endpoint to remove image backgrounds using AI (PNG output)

## Video API

- [Video Queue](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/video/queue): Venice API endpoint to queue video generation requests (image-to-video)

## Audio API

- [Text to Speech](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/audio/speech): Venice API text-to-speech endpoint using tts-kokoro and tts-qwen models
- [Audio Quote](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/audio/quote): Venice API endpoint to get price quotes for audio generation parameters

## Embeddings & Utilities

- [Embeddings](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/embeddings/generate): Venice API endpoint to generate text embeddings using bge-m3 model

## Optional

- [List Characters](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/characters/list): Venice API endpoint to list characters with filtering and sort options
- [Update API Key](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/api_keys/update): Venice API endpoint to update API key settings and consumption limits
- [Billing Usage Analytics](https://docs.venice.ai/api-reference/endpoint/billing/usage-analytics): Beta endpoint for usage analytics by date, model, and API key (cached)
